corpus: Python language documentation (pydoc_data/topics.py) for Python 3.11 and 3.13
counting_rule: No physical pages. Following GUIDE.md for text without pagination, a content unit is an independent, meaningful pydoc topic with >= 1500 normalized characters. Only the Python 3.13 snapshot is counted toward the 30-unit minimum: 42 topics qualify. The 3.11 snapshot is a different version of the same documentation (used for the python_version filter) and is NOT counted, to avoid counting near-duplicates. Topic 'compound' aggregates text of several statement topics (try/for/with/match/class...) — it is upstream content, not something we duplicated.
privacy: Public technical documentation; no personal or confidential data.
